_provenance: Transcribed from a rented RTX 4090 instance run of 2026-09-06 (chain3.log, chain4.log). Raw per-payload scores remain on the GPU host at /workspace/results/judge_scores_*.jsonl and /workspace/results/. Judge: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, 242 real LLMail exploit families, 16,469 near-variants, threshold 0.5, FPR 0.000 on 160 unique benign emails, identical family set in both arms.
_primary: The *_s runs (score-mode=sample) are the valid comparison. The non-_s runs scored from first-token logprobs, where a 0.5 threshold on the two-way softmax ratio is exactly temperature-invariant, so their 'sampled' arm was not sampled (det 0.990 vs 0.995) and their null is uninformative.
_verdict_sampled: CIs overlap -> not significant. Point estimate moves the WRONG WAY for the mechanism (sampling RAISED family survival, 8.65% -> 13.64%). Manipulation was real: determinism fell 0.996 -> 0.725. Mechanism refuted.
_verdict_logprob: UNINFORMATIVE by construction - the temperature knob could not affect a 0.5 threshold on the softmax ratio. Retained only to document the error.

_determinism_detail_T0_logprob.note: vLLM at temperature 0 is NOT bit-reproducible under shuffled batch composition (3.2% identical), but decisions agree 99.5%. Report as a limitation; do not claim a perfectly deterministic arm.
